name: – Stéphanie Yon-Courtin – After § 3 – Am 2
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 3b. Stresses that public ownership and public control of companies of strategic significance to the transition to a socially just and climate-neutral economy are vital to effectively guide, support and accelerate this transition and develop more democratic forms of production; calls on the Commission and the Member States to create an EU framework to facilitate public ownership and public control in such strategic economic sectors;
